title: Compass Digital Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Compass Digital Acquisition Corp. (CDAQ), a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a business combination with Key Mining Corp. (KMC), a critical minerals and infrastructure company with projects in Chile and the United States. The transaction involves a merger structure where Pubco (a new Delaware holding company) will become the publicly-traded parent of both CDAQ and KMC.
key_points: CDAQ entered into a merger agreement with Titan Holdings Corp. (Pubco), structured as a reverse merger combining the SPAC with KMC
KMC is a global critical minerals and infrastructure company with projects in Chile and the United States
CDAQ is registered as an emerging growth company under the Securities Act
The combined entity (Pubco) will be a publicly-traded holding company upon consummation
A registration statement on Form S-4 with proxy statement/prospectus has been filed with the SEC
